All values are given in mg kg-1 soil

\* tre = treatment, amm = soil amended with 300 mg NH4+-N kg-1 soil, con = unamended soil pract = agricultural practices, CBR = conventional tilled beds, PBR = permenant beds

\*\* NA: Not available

Csoil = total C detected in the 0.5 M K2SO4 extract

CO2 = carbondioxide emitted

NO2 = nitrite detected in the 0.5 M K2SO4 extract

NO3 = nitrate detected in the 0.5 M K2SO4 extract

NH4 = ammonium detected in the 0.5 M K2SO4 extract

MinN = sum of mineral N
